LBR.note: The LTA complaints centre covers telecom subscribers, not digital financial services.

facts.fact: LTA commissioner Patrick Honnah says its Universal Access Program is deploying teams to expand connectivity in underserved communities, with 15 remote towers being upgraded from 2G to 4G.
The Liberian Investigator reports Liberia regained its voting rights in the African Telecommunications Union after a waiver of more than US$400,000 in arrears, per LTA chair Clarence Massaquoi.

LBR.note: No rural electricity access figure stated.
